Anyway, thanks for watching Re:Zero episode 2 as well! At 30 minutes it ends insanely fast, but that just means the author is enjoying it that much!

By the way, about the next-episode preview: it won't be attached to the main TV broadcast, and will instead be released on the web. Because the staff brilliantly went all in with, "If we cut the preview, that's 15 more seconds we can use for the main episode!" Seriously, 15 seconds matters, it really matters. So enjoy the main episode!

The same goes for the first episode being an hour long, but things like these time-related considerations are made possible by the tremendous generosity of the staff. Normally, a one-hour anime means double the work, so it's beyond merely difficult. But with this anime, the staff were the ones saying, “We have to do it.” That was how it came together.

We've been blessed in so many ways that I can confidently say this has become a highly satisfying anime, so everyone, please stay with us all the way to the end. Next time, look forward to episode 3: "Elsa-san Gets Serious."
